auth.brand.desc: An OpenAI-compatible protocol aggregating multiple upstream providers with automatic failover and per-token metering. Sign in to create keys, view bills and check call logs.
auth.brand.points.compatible.title: OpenAI-compatible API
auth.brand.points.compatible.desc: Swap base_url in one line and keep your existing SDK, with native streaming SSE.
auth.brand.points.failover.title: Automatic multi-channel failover
auth.brand.points.failover.desc: On upstream errors, traffic fails over to the next channel, routed by priority and weight.
auth.brand.points.metering.title: Precise per-token billing
auth.brand.points.metering.desc: Input / output / cache read & write priced separately — every bill entry is queryable and exportable.
auth.head.loginDesc: Continue with your email or username — you'll be redirected to the page you originally wanted.
auth.head.registerDesc: Sign up and go — no sales call needed; send your first request within a minute of creating a key.
auth.login.errorTooManyAttempts: Too many failed sign-in attempts, please try again later.
auth.register.alreadyExists: This email or username is already taken. Please sign in instead.
auth.form.identifierRequired: Please enter your email or username
auth.form.passwordExtra: At least 8 characters, with both letters and digits
auth.form.passwordComplexity: Must include both letters and digits
auth.form.passwordRegisterPlaceholder: At least 8 chars, letters and digits
auth.head.resetDesc: Set a new password using a code we send to your email. Every device signed in to this account is signed out once it checks out.
auth.reset.success: Password updated — please sign in with the new one
auth.foot.help: Need help? Contact an admin to get an account.
